However, the Router may have been slightly lenient on the 'ties' checkpoint; while present, their structural integrity is questionable (fading into background), which the Router noted in artifacts but still marked 'present' in checkpoints. This is acceptable as they are visually identifiable as ties, even if flawed.

All key geometric and functional checkpoints (shape, neck curve, fabric type) are met. The only deviation is the optional pocket feature, which is correctly absent. The alignment is near-perfect.
artifact_reasoning: Significant artifacts exist but are localized. The text 'LAKE' is illegible/gibberish (confirmed by Text Auditor), constituting a moderate semantic artifact. The left patch shows signs of fusion/lack of stitching detail (texture anomaly). The neck ties fade ambiguously into the background. These issues prevent a perfect artifact score, but the main body of the bib is structurally sound and free of major melting or distortion. The severity is moderate due to the visibility of the text error and the subtle boundary issues.
